newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Phileo Land sells Phileo Allied stake.
newsitem.headline: Phileo Land sells Phileo Allied stake.

text.p: Phileo Land Bhd said it proposes to sell its entire 20 percent stake comprising ordinary shares and loan stocks in financial services firm Phileo Allied Bhd to Phileo Land shareholders.

The proposed offer will raise about 328 million ringgit, which will be used to repay bank borrowings of Phileo Land, the company said in a statement sent on Tuesday to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
Phileo Land said the sale of the holding in Phileo Allied would allow it to focus and expand on its core property development business.

It said its 68.37 million Phileo Allied shares were proposed to be sold to Phileo Land shareholders at 4.00 ringgit a share to minority shareholders on a one-for-three basis, and to the controlling shareholder Phileo Properties Sdn Bhd on a one-for-3.92 basis.

On the loan stocks, 45.027 million ringgit worth of the securities would be sold on the basis of 1.00 ringgit nominal value of the loan stocks for every five existing ordinary shares at 1.20 ringgit per loan stock.
The balance of 553,742 ringgit nominal value of the loan stocks held by Phileo Land after the proposed offer would be placed out in the open market, the statement said.
